successors.name: Kingdom of Germany
successors.text: the Obotrite lands between the Elbe and the Baltic, under Hermann Billung's march

ledger.x: 793: the Obotrites enter the record as a confederation of Polabian Slav tribes on the Baltic coast.
798: the Obotrites beat the Nordalbingian Saxons at Bornhoeved.
804: the fighting for Nordalbingia ends with Charlemagne's award.
804: Charlemagne awards Holstein to the Obotrites.
808: Gudfred of Denmark strikes the Obotrites.
810: Gudfred is murdered by one of his housecarls and the Danish pressure ends.
814: Charlemagne's death returns Nordalbingia to the Saxons.

wars.name: Saxon Wars (Obotrite share)
wars.outcome: The Obotrites, Charlemagne's allies, beat the Nordalbingian Saxons at Bornhoeved (798); the Saxon land in Holstein north of the Elbe was awarded to them in 804, and 'The areas north of the Elbe were at first given to the Obotrites' (Nordalbingia page); in 814…

wars.name: Danish war of Gudfred against the Obotrites
wars.outcome: Gudfred destroyed Reric and subjected the Slav lands in 808; Drozko returned in 809 with Saxon auxiliaries, attacked the Wilzi and recovered the lands; Gudfred was murdered in 810.

wars.name: East Frankish campaign against the Abodrites, Linones and Sorbs
wars.outcome: Louis the Younger and Thachulf were sent against the tribes in 858; the page gives no result.

wars.name: Billung March wars
wars.outcome: Hermann Billung was given rule over the Obotrite tribes in 936; in 955 the Obotrite chief Nako rose with Hermann's nephews and was completely defeated on the Recknitz by King Otto.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for the Obotrite lands: the Elbe against the Saxons, the Baltic coast and the Slav frontiers are approximate.
